title.narrative: Improving Target TB?s monitoring, evaluation and learning systems

description.narrative: Target TB is a specialist charity working with partner organisations in Africa and Asia. As a dynamic, growing organisation we are increasingly seeing the need to develop our monitoring and evaluation systems to: 1) Improve how we monitor project and organisational objectives, with systems clearly understood by Target TB and our partners 2) Evaluate our work more effectively, to help us evidence the impact of our work, highlight key learning points, and disseminate information to others so as to build best practice 3) Use learning from monitoring and evaluation to input into future programme development, share findings with other stakeholders, influence policy discussions, and showcase the value of our work. This project will enable Target TB to undertake a review of existing systems through which we monitor, evaluate and learn. Review recommendations will lead to the development of new systems which we will train both Target TB and partners on prior to implementation. The improved systems will help us to plan high quality, more effective programmes, demonstrate the significant value of our partners’ work in contributing to global health and poverty-alleviation goals, and improve our contribution to relevant policy and decision making forums in the UK and internationally.

recipient-country.narrative: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland (the)
